verdict.rationale: Trello's Power-Up framework lets developers add native-feeling UI extension points: board buttons, card badges on the card front, dynamic card-back buttons, and attachment sections that pull in third-party data. A skeleton project and a React/TypeScript sample support building them, and marketplace submission is available. However, the evidence only shows card- and board-level surfaces, not full custom views or dashboard widgets. missing for 10: documented custom board/view types, dashboard widget capability, design-system or native-styling guidance for Power-Up UI, independent hands-on corroboration.
